current_round: Task 1 — Make Ctrl+/ reach Toggle Comment
tests_added: Ctrl+/ reaches SqlEditor Toggle Comment and does not insert a stray slash.
design_decisions: A QScintilla keyPressEvent override compares the incoming QKeySequence to one module-level Ctrl+/ sequence, triggers the existing Toggle Comment QAction, accepts the event, and delegates every other event to the base class.
The QScintilla stub requires a non-optional QKeyEvent and parameter name e; the implementation matches that contract while retaining a defensive None return.
PyQt's QTest stubs model the static helpers as instance methods, so the focused test keeps the required runtime calls and uses narrow no-matching-overload suppressions.
The existing QAction retains WidgetShortcut context for its menu presentation; the key event route is what makes the shortcut work in QScintilla.

results.quality_gate_recovery: Initial ty gate rejected QKeyEvent | None and a0 because QsciScintillaBase expects keyPressEvent(e: QKeyEvent); the corrected override passed the full gate. The commit hook then exposed PyQt QTest static-helper stub overloads, resolved with two narrow no-matching-overload suppressions.
